blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm ke do bare qadam hain:

items: Generate: is qadam mein algorithm masle ke mumkina hal banata hai. Yeh hal randomly (tasadufi, bina tarteeb), systematically (tarteeb se) ya kisi heuristic (tajurbe par mabni andaze ka qaida) ki bunyad par banaye ja sakte hain.

Test: hal banane ke baad algorithm use masle ki requirements ya constraints (pabandiyon) par jaanchta hai. Agar hal tamam sharait poori kare to use valid (durust) mana jata hai. Agar nahi, to algorithm naya hal banata hai aur yahi amal dohrata hai.

blocks.prompt: Generate and Test algorithm ke bunyadi qadam bataiye (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: 1) Ek mumkina hal banayein (generate). 2) Use tamam sharait par jaanchein (test). 3) Agar paas ho to usi hal par ruk jayein. 4) Warna naya hal bana kar phir jaanchein, jab tak hal na mile ya mumkina hal khatam na hon.

items: Do qadam: generate (randomly, systematically ya heuristic se) aur test (tamam constraints par); durust hal milne tak chakkar.
